If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is <0.3 in the last 3 days and forecast is falling, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is flat, shift mid-period forecast upward by 0.5–1.0% to reflect bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is flat, shift mid-period forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% to reflect bearish sentiment.  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is rising, reduce early-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to prevent premature overbought bias.  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is falling, increase early-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to prevent premature oversold bias.
